Closed-Loop Valve.name: Closed-Loop Valve
Closed-Loop Valve.description: For the rest of the scene the user recycles their vented steam, drawing the moisture and heat back through their skin before it dissipates so even dry air or a freezing room cannot weaken the Quirk. Each turn they can fire a pinpoint pressure valve jet across a street that lifts a bus-sized slab of rubble, bursts a vault door, or deals heavy force and fire damage to one target; held back, it cools in flight and only pins them to a wall. Keeping the hot loop sealed builds core heat, so if the user takes a heavy hit the loop breaks and triggers their Drawback at once. Strain: severe.
